teapot_note: A plain white teapot is already calm, and a blue dot you find only by lifting the lid adds nothing to the surface. It is a small secret that costs no clutter.
moth_note: Welcome the moth, with one change: draw each wing as a page of three or four soft lines instead of tiny writing, which turns to noise at small sizes. Let it land only in the margin beside the text, never on a control or on the words being written.
home_why: They are not guardians, so a page of their own keeps the Marginarium uncluttered and says plainly who is who.
to_codex: Keep the teapot plain; the dot under the lid is the right size of secret.
to_claude: Soften the wings to a few quiet lines, and let the moth land only in margins.
